lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਲੇਖਾ ਨਿਬੜੈ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh pat siu lekhaa nibaRai bakhase siphat bha(n)daar ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh's account is settled with honor; the Lord blesses him with the treasure of His Praise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਥੈ ਹਥੁ ਨ ਅਪੜੈ ਕੂਕ ਨ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: othai hath na apaRai kook na suneeai pukaar ||
lines.translation: No one's hands can reach there; no one will hear anyone's cries.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਥੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੇਲੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਢਿ ਲਏ ਅੰਤੀ ਵਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: othai satigur belee hovai kadh lae a(n)tee vaar ||
lines.translation: The True Guru will be your best friend there; at the very last instant, He will save you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਨਾ ਜੰਤਾ ਨੋ ਹੋਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਹੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: enaa ja(n)taa no hor sevaa nahee satigur sir karataar ||6||
lines.translation: These beings should serve no other than the True Guru or the Creator Lord above the heads of all. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਪੂਕਾਰਦਾ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabeehaa jis no too pookaaradaa tis no lochai sabh koi ||
lines.translation: O rainbird, the One unto whom you call - everyone longs for that Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਵਸਸੀ ਵਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: apanee kirapaa kar kai vasasee van trin hariaa hoi ||
lines.translation: When He grants His Grace, it rains, and the forests and fields blossom forth in their greenery.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee paaeeai viralaa boojhai koi ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, He is found; only a rare few understand this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹਦਿਆ ਉਠਦਿਆ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bahadiaa uthadiaa nit dhiaaeeai sadaa sadaa sukh hoi ||
lines.translation: Sitting down and standing up, meditate continually on Him, and be at peace forever and ever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਵਰਸਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak a(n)mrit sad hee varasadaa guramukh devai har soi ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Ambrosial Nectar rains down forever; the Lord gives it to the Gurmukh. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਮਲਿ ਹੋਈ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਕਰੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kalamal hoee medanee aradaas kare liv laai ||
lines.translation: When the people of the world are suffering in pain, they call upon the Lord in loving prayer.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਕੰਨੁ ਦੇ ਧੀਰਕ ਦੇਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachai suniaa ka(n)n de dheerak devai sahaj subhaai ||
lines.translation: The True Lord naturally listens and hears and gives comfort.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੈ ਨੋ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਵੁਠਾ ਛਹਬਰ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: i(n)drai no phuramaaiaa vuthaa chhahabar laai ||
lines.translation: He commands the god of rain, and the rain pours down in torrents.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਹੁ ਘਣਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: an dhan upajai bahu ghanaa keemat kahan na jaai ||
lines.translation: Corn and wealth are produced in great abundance and prosperity; their value cannot be estimated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਦੇਦਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam salaahi too sabhanaa jeeaa dedaa rijak sa(n)baahi ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord; He reaches out and gives sustenance to all beings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਧੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jit khaadhai sukh oopajai phir dookh na laagai aai ||2||
lines.translation: Eating this, peace is produced, and the mortal never again suffers in pain. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਤੂ ਸਚੇ ਲੈਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jeeu sachaa sach too sache laihi milaai ||
lines.translation: O Dear Lord, You are the Truest of the True. You blend those who are truthful into Your Own Being.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਦੂਜੀ ਤਰਫ ਹੈ ਕੂੜਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: doojai doojee taraph hai kooR milai na miliaa jaai ||
lines.translation: Those caught in duality are on the side of duality; entrenched in falsehood, they cannot merge into the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜੋੜਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਿਐ ਆਪੇ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਦੇਇ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape joR vichhoRiai aape kudarat dei dikhaai ||
lines.translation: You Yourself unite, and You Yourself separate; You display Your Creative Omnipotence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mohu sog vijog hai poorab likhiaa kamaai ||
lines.translation: Attachment brings the sorrow of separation; the mortal acts in accordance with pre-ordained destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau balihaaree tin kau jo har charanee rahai liv laai ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who remain lovingly attached to the Lord's Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਹੈ ਐਸੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu jal mahi kamal alipat hai aisee banat banaai ||
lines.translation: They are like the lotus which remains detached, floating upon the water.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਜਿਨੑ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: se sukheee sadaa sohane jinh vichahu aap gavaai ||
lines.translation: They are peaceful and beautiful forever; they eradicate self-conceit from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑ ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਕਦੇ ਨਹੀ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: tinh sog vijog kade nahee jo har kai a(n)k samaai ||7||
lines.translation: They never suffer sorrow or separation; they are merged in the Being of the Lord. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਸਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak so saalaaheeai jis vas sabh kichh hoi ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, praise the Lord; everything is in His power.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੈ ਸਰੇਵਿਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀਹੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tisai sarevihu praaneeho tis bin avar na koi ||
lines.translation: Serve Him, O mortal beings; there is none other than Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh har prabh man vasai taa(n) sadaa sadaa sukh hoi ||
lines.translation: The Lord God abides within the mind of the Gurmukh, and then he is at peace, forever and ever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਸਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਸਭ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahasaa mool na hovaee sabh chi(n)taa vichahu jaai ||
lines.translation: He is never cynical; all anxiety has been taken out from within him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo kichh hoi s sahaje hoi kahanaa kichhoo na jaai ||
lines.translation: Whatever happens, happens naturally; no one has any say about it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਾਂ ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa saahib man vasai taa(n) man chi(n)diaa phal paai ||
lines.translation: When the True Lord abides in the mind, then the mind's desires are fulfilled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਆਖਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਣੇ ਜਿ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਪੰਨੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tin kaa aakhiaa aap sune j laian pa(n)nai paai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, He Himself hears the words of those, whose accounts are in His Hands. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਦਾ ਵਰਸਦਾ ਬੂਝਨਿ ਬੂਝਣਹਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit sadaa varasadaa boojhan boojhanahaar ||
lines.translation: The Ambrosial Nectar rains down continually; realize this through realization.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh jinhee bujhiaa har a(n)mrit rakhiaa ur dhaar ||
lines.translation: Those who, as Gurmukh, realize this, keep the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar enshrined within their hearts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har a(n)mrit peevahi sadaa ra(n)g raate haumai trisanaa maar ||
lines.translation: They drink in the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar, and remain forever imbued with the Lord; they conquer egotism and thirsty desires.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਵਰਸੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit har kaa naam hai varasai kirapaa dhaar ||
lines.translation: The Name of the Lord is Ambrosial Nectar; the Lord showers His Grace, and it rains down.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh nadaree aaiaa har aatam raam muraar ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh comes to behold the Lord, the Supreme Soul. ||2||
